notes: The supplied label is retained. Independent championship briefings identify the GT/Blancpain course as the full Mistral-straight 1A-V2 configuration. This trace follows that documented course rather than inferring a chicane from the catalogue label. Historical naming and measured-length differences still require review.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.
Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union, EU-DEM layers.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
